in_marathi.name: Atmaan
in_marathi.long_meaning: Atmaan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Atmaan is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Atman’, which means self or soul. In Hinduism, the self or soul is believed to be a part of the divine Brahman. The name Atmaan signifies the inherent spiritual nature of an individual and encourages the exploration of one’s inner self.
